body: 将上传2D两房平面图转换成3D轴测建筑图，保持外轮廓、偏左隔墙、隔墙门、右房底边入户门和顶边两扇窗位置与比例。墙体统一拉伸高度，无屋顶，蓝图深蓝背景、浅蓝实体和白色细边线、柔和环境遮蔽。相机从平面图下边偏右的方向俯视，能看到两房内部，无家具、无文字。4:3。

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.
instructions.zh-Hans: 按列出的顺序上传参考图。本例使用合成输入素材。

en.title: Floor plan to blueprint axonometric
en.description: Two rooms, the offset divider, two windows and both doors correspond to the plan. This is the first generated view; the separately recorded reverse-view step uses this image as its input.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

Two rooms, the offset divider, two windows and both doors correspond to the plan. This is the first generated view; the separately recorded reverse-view step uses this image as its input.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 42. [Source](https://github.com/qzh3722/awesome-nano-banana-spatial-design/blob/main/README.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.

## 使用方法

复制本图实际使用的完整提示词。修改主体后属于尚未验证的新变体。生成前，按顺序上传运行记录中展示的合成参考图。

## 观察结果

两房、偏置隔墙、双窗与两扇门对应平面图。本图为第一轮轴测，另存的反向视角运行以本图为输入。
